validity.researcher_notes: This row (LengthKnownKm already 0.00, RouteAccuracy 'no route') is Kinder Morgan subsidiary Sierrita Gas Pipeline LLC's compressor-only capacity expansion at the US-Mexico border crossing in Pima County, AZ (FERC Docket Nos. CP18-37-000 / CP18-38-000, the 'Sierrita Compressor Expansion Project'), which raised the design capacity of existing Line No. 2177 to 627,000,000 cf/d -- a total-capacity figure whose increment over the pipeline's prior ~200 MMcf/d design capacity (627-200=427) matches this row's Capacity value of 427.00 MMcf/d. FERC's Federal Register notice of the EA (govinfo.gov, primary/gov source) lists the ENTIRE facility scope: 'one new 15,900 horsepower compressor station,' 'approximately 1,000 feet of suction and discharge piping and various station yard auxiliary facilities,' 'one new 10-inch Ultrasonic meter,' and relocation of an existing mainline valve -- no new mainline pipe segment or lateral. An independent local-news source (AZPM, azpm.org, 2019) corroborates: 'only a compressor station is being constructed, not new pipe,' expected to 'more than double the pipeline's capacity.' The wiki's '36 inches' is the SYSTEM/mainline diameter of the existing 61-mile Sierrita Gas Pipeline (Line No. 2177), not a spec for this expansion project, which lays none. Per the compression-only-expansion rule, LengthKnown=0/Diameter=blank is the correct state and this flag resolves as a confirmation, not a fill. FLAG FOR A HUMAN (out of this brief's Diameter/Operator scope, noted for awareness only): P2614 ('Puerto Libertad Expansion,' Capacity 427 MMcf/d) and P2615 ('Sierrita Pima Expansion Project,' Capacity 320 MMcf/d) both trace to the SAME underlying CP18-37/CP18-38 compressor project and may be two GEM rows for one physical expansion (627,000,000 cf/d design capacity vs. the ~322,794 Dth/d of firm service the project was certificated to add) -- a possible-duplicate/granularity question a human should adjudicate; not something I resolved or staged as an action here.
